# Mail Agent

> Email inboxes for AI agents and E2E tests. Create an inbox per run, wait for the signup, login or reset email, and get the next step back: an OTP or a link, not raw HTML.

API base: https://api.webmailagent.com
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer ma_...`
Free key (10 inboxes, 60 requests/min, 500 emails/month), one email confirmation: https://webmailagent.com/get-key
Pro: $29/month, 100 inboxes, 5000 emails/month: https://webmailagent.com/upgrade.html

## Quick flow

1. `POST /v1/inboxes` with `{"label": "ci-run-42"}` returns `{ id, address }`.
2. Use `address` in the signup or login form of the app under test.
3. `GET /v1/inboxes/{id}/wait?timeout=60` waits for the email (408 `timeout` comes with a diagnosis).
4. `GET /v1/inboxes/{id}/extract` returns `otp`, `primaryLink` and `links`.
5. `DELETE /v1/inboxes/{id}` when done.

One call for steps 1 to 4: `POST /v1/inboxes/open`.
No SMTP in CI: `POST /v1/inboxes/{id}/simulate` with `{"scenario": "otp"}` injects a test email.
Stuck: `GET /v1/inboxes/{id}/diagnose`.
Plan, limits and usage: `GET /v1/me`.
Webhooks are signed (`MailAgent-Signature`); secret from `GET /v1/webhook-secret`: https://webmailagent.com/docs/webhooks.html

## MCP

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add mailagent -e MAILAGENT_API_KEY=ma_... -- npx -y -p @mailagent/mcp@latest mailagent-mcp
```

- [Agent setup](https://webmailagent.com/docs/agents.html): MCP, skills, Codex
- [QA and CI](https://webmailagent.com/docs/qa.html): Playwright and Cypress starters

- [Terminal](https://webmailagent.com/term): the same API as typed commands
- [Source](https://github.com/navorina-labs/MailAgent)

## Rules

Inboxes are for testing your own product and for agents acting for their owner. No bulk signups on other sites. Keys are rate limited and can be revoked.
